capabilities: Create structured case study notes with fixed sections
Log inspiration notes with source URL, tags, and notes
Generate mood board notes from an image grid template
Browse case studies and inspiration in a sidebar panel
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for tracking design case studies, inspiration sources, and mood boards as linked portfolio content.
summary: Designer portfolio manager that creates case study, inspiration, and mood board notes and browses them in a sidebar.
